_comment: Rater roster. Replace the placeholder names with your lab members, keep the ids stable,
and redeploy. Order matters: allocation is derived from a rater's position in this list,
so reordering or removing an entry reshuffles who codes what. To drop someone after
coding has started, leave their entry in place and mark "active": false.
replication = how many independent raters see each narrative. 3 gives a majority vote
and a per-rater reliability estimate. calibration_n narratives are coded by EVERYONE,
so the whole group can be compared on the same items before their own slice begins.
